title: Proper geometric-point derived direct image preserves copowers
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, k an algebraically closed field, and p : X → Spec k proper. For every indexing type I and every object E in the ordinary unbounded derived category of small-etale Λ-module sheaves on X, the right derived direct image Rp_* preserves the coproduct cocone of the constant I-family at E.

source.place: Lemma 59.96.3 and its coproduct comparison argument

proof.text: Represent E by a K-injective complex. The termwise coproduct of I copies is again direct-image-acyclic by the finite torsion cohomological-dimension bound and filtered-colimit compatibility of proper etale cohomology. The finite-cohomological-dimension acyclic-complex theorem computes the unbounded derived direct image termwise, and the resulting degree-zero comparison is the canonical copower comparison. Localizing gives an isomorphism of the image cocone with a coproduct cocone.

proof_origin.place: Finite-coefficient proper cohomology and derived coproduct comparison
